  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "The {{ing_01|cereal}} is soaked; {{ing_02|chickpeas}}, {{ing_03|lentils}} and {{ing_04|peas}} are crushed and boiled with it."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "When well cooked, add {{ing_05|plenty of oil}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Now cut {{ing_06|green herbs}}, {{ing_07|leeks}}, {{ing_08|coriander}}, {{ing_09|dill}}, {{ing_10|fennel}}, {{ing_11|beets}}, {{ing_12|mallows}}, {{ing_13|cabbage strunks}}, all soft and green and finely cut, and put in a pot."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "The {{ing_13|cabbage}} cook [separately. Also] crush {{ing_14|fennel seed}}, {{ing_15|origany}}, {{ing_16|sylphium}} and {{ing_17|lovage}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "And when crushed, add {{ing_18|broth}} to taste, pour this over the porridge, stir it together and use some {{ing_19|finely chopped cabbage stems}} to sprinkle on top."
    }
  ],
